mapper.select: SELECT e.exam_id, e.title, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.timezone, e.duration_minutes, e.status, CASE WHEN e.current_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_exam_version_question evq WHERE evq.version_id = e.current_version_id ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_exam_question eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.exam_id ) END AS question_count FROM tb_user_exam ue JOIN tb_exam e ON ue.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ue.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ue.create_time DESC
SELECT user_id, score, exam_rank FROM tb_user_exam WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY exam_rank
